parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: The lid of the kettle is made of heat-resistant plastic and fits on top of the kettle body to cover the opening.
parts.Functional_description: It prevents water from spilling and helps retain heat during boiling. It can be removed for filling or cleaning.
parts.Movement_description: It can be lifted or rotated slightly to open or close the kettle.

parts.name: Handle
parts.Basic_description: The handle is an ergonomically shaped plastic part attached to the side of the kettle.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the user to safely hold and pour the kettle without touching the hot body.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move relative to the kettle body.

parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: The button is a small plastic component located near the base of the kettle.
parts.Functional_description: It is used to switch the kettle on or off, activating the heating element.
parts.Movement_description: It moves slightly inward when pressed and returns to its original position when released.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the main container of the kettle, made of stainless steel for durability and heat resistance.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the water and contains the heating element that boils the water.
parts.Movement_description: It is stationary and serves as the structural core of the kettle.
